variants.headline: Still in view: the colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved.

variants.headline: Still in view: ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved.

variants.headline: Still in view: an Assembly election enters the record
variants.sub: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.

This paper reserves judgment on {target}. Holding an election establishes that a contest occurred; it does not settle every question about the conduct or merits of those involved.
